interventions.detail: README clone URL uses SSH (git@github.com), which requires keys; used https clone
Installed torch 2.3.1 / torchvision 0.18.1 from the PyTorch CPU wheel index instead of default CUDA builds
Quick-start dtype line calls torch.cuda.get_device_capability() which fails on CPU; used torch.float32 and no CUDA autocast
Installed repo editable (pip install -e . --no-deps) / set PYTHONPATH so `import vggt` works outside the repo dir
Pre-downloaded facebook/VGGT-1B weights into HF_HOME=/work/hf_cache during setup and exported HF_HOME in env.sh
